verdict.rationale: Brave Search API documents dedicated verticals — News, Image, Video search, Local/POI search, and finance/sports/weather via Rich Search API — plus date-based freshness filters (pd for last 24 hours) that support news-vertical freshness needs. The MCP server further confirms distinct endpoints for web, news, image, video, and local search. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark of category-filter accuracy or coverage breadth, and no explicit example of a single 'category' query parameter unifying verticals (endpoints are separate rather than one filter param).
